page0.text:
"ZOUKEN!!!"
I'll settle this once and for all.
Zouken should be somewhere in this house. I'll find him and kill him...!

page1.text:
"Shit! Where are you, old bastard!?"
He's nowhere to be found in the house.
His presence slips away with each passing minute.
"Ho ho. Your blood is running so high that you can't even make a sound decision.
I thought you a more clever sort."
His laugh fades away.

page2.text:
"Hah... hah, hah, haah...!"
...Zouken isn't here.
He was never in the building to begin with.
He's an insect-user, so there's nothing here except for his bug familiars...!

page3.text:
"Are you satisfied? Now go home, Shirou Emiya.
Soon, Sakura will consume Illyasviel. You'd better hurry back, or you won't get to witness the birth of the monster you reared."
"You old fucker!!!"
